description: Capture the closer details: `{{objection_type}}`, `{{interest_level}}`, `{{last_name}}`, `{{monthly_leak}}`, `{{pain_points}}` (APPEND only). Call it when you've gauged interest and handled objections — once before you're done here.
name: extract_closer_details

variables.description: Type of objection raised during the conversation
variables.name: objection_type

variables.description: Prospect's interest level from their response to the value prop
variables.name: interest_level
last_name
variables.description: Prospect's last name if mentioned during the conversation

variables.name: monthly_leak
variables.description: The calculated monthly revenue loss from the leak reveal (their numbers only), e.g. "$4,300/mo"
Updated comma-separated list if NEW problems were mentioned. ADD to the existing list — keep all previous items.
variables.name: pain_points

description: Capture the three leak-reveal numbers the prospect just gave: `{{missed_calls_weekly}}` (voicemail calls per week, number only), `{{close_rate_pct}}` (percent as a number — 50 means 50%), `{{avg_job_value}}` (average job/ticket in dollars, number only). Call it once all three are captured, BEFORE calling calculate_monthly_leak. Never fabricate a number the prospect didn't give.
name: extract_leak_inputs

variables.description: How many calls hit voicemail per week (number only, e.g. "20")
variables.name: missed_calls_weekly
close_rate_pct
variables.description: Percent of missed calls that would have booked, as a number (e.g. "50" for 50%)
Average job or ticket value in dollars, number only (e.g. "650")
variables.name: avg_job_value

name: calculate_monthly_leak
description: Computes the monthly revenue leak from the prospect's own three numbers (already captured as {{missed_calls_weekly}}, {{close_rate_pct}}, {{avg_job_value}}). Call it ONLY after extract_leak_inputs has captured all three. It returns the leak rounded DOWN to the lower end (conservative) as {{monthly_leak}}, e.g. "4,200". If it returns ok:false with missing inputs, ask the prospect for the missing number(s) and call it again.

variables.name: closer_completed
variables.description: true ONLY after: When their interest level is gauged after quantifying their loss.

name: closer_completed
description: Set closer_completed to true ONLY after: When their interest level is gauged after quantifying their loss. Do not set it early.
